description: This file contains the code-behind logic for an 'EditTheory' web page in an online examination system. It handles page load events, navigation button clicks, and dynamic population of course selection dropdowns based on the selected semester.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.EditTheory
classes.description: Code-behind class for the EditTheory.aspx web page, managing user interactions and course selection logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial loading of the page.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the admin queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Stores selected course information in session state.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Dynamically populates the course drop-down list based on the selected semester.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when the semester dropdown selection changes, updating the course list accordingly.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Currently empty; available for handling course selection changes.
